steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Component 1 (Portfolio) is worth 60% — it must show a sustained project plus supporting studies that demonstrate all four AOs. | Key Fact: Your portfolio should show a CLEAR NARRATIVE: from starting point, through research and experimentation, to a resolved personal response. | Key Fact: Supporting studies show breadth — additional experiments, artist responses and explorations that complement your main project. | Key Fact: Written annotation must use specialist vocabulary and show REFLECTIVE THINKING — not just descriptions of what you did.
